params.script_inline:
import sys, json

d = json.load(sys.stdin)["body"]
calls = [m for m in d.get("messages", []) if m.get("type") == "tool_call"]
if not calls:
    # Echo guard: tool results and error replies end here (empty multi-send).
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([]))
    sys.exit(0)

out = []
for i, c in enumerate(calls):
    wrapper = json.loads(c.get("text", "{}"))
    name = wrapper.get("name", "unknown")
    args = wrapper.get("arguments", "{}")
    if not isinstance(args, str):
        args = json.dumps(args)
    out.append({
        "header": {"tool_name": name},
        "messages": [{
            "origin": "assistant",
            "type": "tool_call",
            "id": c.get("id", "call-%d" % i),
            "text": args,
        }],
    })
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))

description.purpose: Unwraps the agent's OpenAI-form tool_calls ({name, arguments}) into one routed tool_call turn per call, with hop.tool_name as the lane discriminator.
description.use_when: In front of any set of tool cells, including the timer (GH #81).
description.not_in_scope: No argument validation, no fan-in bookkeeping.
description.emits_meaning: One message per tool call: the raw args as the tool_call turn's text, hop.tool_name for routing. No tool_calls in the input yields nothing (terminal empty multi-send).
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: assistant tool_call turns in OpenAI function-call form.
examples: {name: remind, arguments: {op: add, ...}} -> one message with hop.tool_name = remind
